description: Repost (retweet) ONE post from the brand’s X account, or take the repost back with undo:true. A repost is public at once on the brand’s timeline, so only repost a post the user named or approved. One post per call. The reply states what X reports afterwards. Costs credits (X bills per API call). Needs X connected.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

postId.description: the post’s id, or its x.com link

name: repost_on_x
title: Repost a post on X
